instruction.text: What four things should you remember when crossing the road? Fill in the gaps.

atoms.text: Help Eloise get to school safely by following the Green Cross Code step by step.

atoms.b: Step 1: Find a ((++safe dangerous)) place to ((++cross sit_down)).

instruction.text: Where is it safer for Eloise to cross? Select the correct image.

feedback.end: If there’s no pedestrian crossing nearby, you should only cross at a place where you can see clearly in all directions. Make sure there’s a pavement on the other side that you can cross to.

atoms.b: Step 2: ((++Stop Run)) just before you get to the ((++kerb bridge)).

instruction.text: Drag Eloise to where she should stop on the left side of the road.

feedback.end: You should keep some distance from the road so you can look around for any traffic.

atoms.b: Step 3: ((++Look Smile)) all around for traffic and ((++listen sing)).

instruction.text: Select all the traffic Eloise should look out for.

feedback.finish: It’s important to listen too because you’ll sometimes hear traffic before you see it.

atoms.b: Step 4: If ((++traffic rain)) is coming, let it ((++pass fall)).

instruction.text: When is it safe for Eloise to cross? Select the correct image.

feedback.end: Keep looking and listening and make sure only to cross when there is a safe gap in traffic.

atoms.b: Step 5: When it is safe, go ((++straight diagonally)) across the road - do not run. Keep ((++looking skipping)) and listening while you cross.

instruction.text: Drag Eloise to the other side of the road to help her cross.

feedback.end: Stay alert the whole time while crossing. More traffic might appear or there might also be cyclists to watch out for.

instruction.text: Eloise now has to cross a road with lots of parked cars. Select the place where she should cross.

feedback.end: You should always try to avoid crossing between parked vehicles. If you have to, make sure to only cross where there is space between vehicles, and make sure their engines are not running.

instruction.text: Eloise just has to cross one more road to get to school. Find the person in the image who can help her cross safely.

feedback.end: A lollipop person controls the traffic around a school. They will signal to you when it is safe to cross, and you should cross in front of them.
